content.short: HashKey Global is HashKey Group's international exchange, licensed in Bermuda, for spot trading of BTC, ETH, SOL and HSK.
content.description: HashKey Global serves users outside Hong Kong under a Class F Digital Asset Business licence from the Bermuda Monetary Authority, and it is audited by a Big Four firm. After KYC, customers deposit fiat or crypto and trade the main pairs, including HashKey's own HSK token. Most customer assets are kept in cold storage, and hot-wallet balances are insured at no extra cost. It lists more than 20 spot pairs, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and HSK, and has futures products on its roadmap.
content.meta: Bermuda-licensed international exchange from HashKey Group with mostly cold-stored, insured assets. Explore HashKey Global on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
